2nd Municipal District (Pangrati, Mets, Neos Kosmos) — Athens, Greece

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

This district covers Pangrati, Zappeion, Mets, Kynosargous, Gouva and Neos Kosmos. Several knifepoint robberies were reported in Pangrati during 2025-2026, including at a betting shop, a gas station and against a taxi driver, and a group knife attack on a 15-year-old was reported in Neos Kosmos. Mets, Zappeion, Kynosargous and Gouva have no documented pattern of incidents in the sources checked. Given the recurring but isolated armed-robbery reports concentrated at night in parts of the district, day is rated green and night is rated yellow. Sources checked: Skai; in.gr/Dimokratia; Enikos; Mega TV/LiFO; ΤΟ ΒΗΜΑ/MEGA; Tripadvisor Athens Forum.
